title: 魚道水理設計
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 從水池落差、孔口流量與能量密度開始，接續游泳能力、入口誘導、休息區與篩網比較。課程不提供通用魚類流速標準，而要求把魚種、體長、季節和水溫寫入設計條件，並透過偵測率及多段通過率分析，區分水理可行性與真正的遷移成果。
summaryEn: Start with pool drops, opening discharge and energy density, then examine swimming ability, attraction, resting areas and screening. No universal fish velocity limit is supplied. Species, body size, season and temperature belong in the design conditions. Detection efficiency and passage through multiple reaches distinguish a hydraulically plausible facility from demonstrated migration outcomes.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「池間落差與射流」與「開口流量與係數」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pool drops and jet velocity" and "Opening discharge and coefficient": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「池間落差與射流」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pool drops and jet velocity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。理想能量式只提供速度尺度，真實射流會收縮、耗散並與池內回流互動，不能用它代替魚所選路徑的速度。魚種、體長、水溫與游泳時間共同決定能力，短時爆發速度也不同於可持續速度。設計應先描述目標族群與季節，再把局部水理和可供停留的空間連成一條可走通的路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「池間落差與射流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. An ideal energy equation gives a velocity scale, while real jets contract, dissipate and interact with recirculation. It does not describe every route selected by a fish. Species, length, temperature and duration affect swimming ability, and burst speed differs from sustained speed. Define the target population and season before linking hydraulic conditions with connected resting opportunities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pool drops and jet velocity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「池間落差與射流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pool drops and jet velocity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 池間落差與射流
knowledge.text: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。理想能量式只提供速度尺度，真實射流會收縮、耗散並與池內回流互動，不能用它代替魚所選路徑的速度。
knowledge.textEn: Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. An ideal energy equation gives a velocity scale, while real jets contract, dissipate and interact with recirculation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「魚道水理設計」的「池間落差與射流：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「洪水量測與河道模型」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Pool drops and jet velocity: mechanism and system paths” in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Flood gauging and river model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「池間落差與射流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pool drops and jet velocity" is correct?
options: 池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會
魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。
流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
optionsEn: Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage.
A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
quiz.explanation: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「池間落差與射流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pool drops and jet velocity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。適用邊界：忽略損失的局部速度尺度，不是魚種可通過限值或池內平均流速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Applicable boundary: Local ideal velocity scale without losses, not a species passage limit or pool average. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。適用邊界：忽略損失的局部速度尺度，不是魚種可通過限值或池內平均流速。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Applicable boundary: Local ideal velocity scale without losses, not a species passage limit or pool average.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「池間落差與射流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pool drops and jet velocity", which statement holds?
options: 魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度
名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。
optionsEn: A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank
Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「池間落差與射流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pool drops and jet velocity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。將瞬時峰值與時間平均分列，並記錄目標魚體長與水溫，避免把一支流速計的平均值當成完整通行環境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Separate instantaneous peaks from time averages, recording fish length and water temperature so one meter average is not mistaken for the whole passage environment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將落差增加一倍重算理想速度，與速度也加倍的假設比較。畫出一條包含休息區的通行路徑，標示仍需取得的魚種能力及局部流速資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the drop and compare ideal velocity with a doubled-speed assumption. Draw a connected route including refuges and identify the species-performance and local velocity observations still needed to assess passage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。將瞬時峰值與時間平均分列，並記錄目標魚體長與水溫，避免把一支流速計的平均值當成完整通行環境。
knowledge.textEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Separate instantaneous peaks from time averages, recording fish length and water temperature so one meter average is not mistaken for the whole passage environment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將落差增加一倍重算理想速度，與速度也加倍的假設比較。畫出一條包含休息區的通行路徑，標示仍需取得的魚種能力及局部流速資料。
knowledge.textEn: Double the drop and compare ideal velocity with a doubled-speed assumption. Draw a connected route including refuges and identify the species-performance and local velocity observations still needed to assess passage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「池間落差與射流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pool drops and jet velocity"?
options: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流
optionsEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
quiz.explanation: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「池間落差與射流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pool drops and jet velocity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。即使每池落差相同，也需檢查射流方向及避流區是否彼此連通。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Equal pool drops therefore still require checking jet orientation and connectivity between lower-velocity refuge areas. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計應先描述目標族群與季節，再把局部水理和可供停留的空間連成一條可走通的路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Define the target population and season before linking hydraulic conditions with connected resting opportunities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。即使每池落差相同，也需檢查射流方向及避流區是否彼此連通。
knowledge.textEn: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Equal pool drops therefore still require checking jet orientation and connectivity between lower-velocity refuge areas.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「池間落差與射流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pool drops and jet velocity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。
流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest.
A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
quiz.explanation: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開口流量與係數」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Opening discharge and coefficient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。用水深乘寬度建立面積之前，要確認開口是否完全被水淹沒，否則出流型態可能不同。相同流量可以經不同面積形成不同速度與剪切分布，因此滿足供水量並不等於滿足通行條件。控制計算應與入口誘導、下游尾水及池內水位一起閉合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開口流量與係數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An opening converts level difference into discharge. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses but changes with geometry, edges and submergence. Before using width times height, verify that the opening is fully wetted; otherwise a different flow relation may apply. The same discharge through different areas produces different velocities and shear distributions, so supplying enough water does not establish passage suitability. Close the calculation with attraction flow, tailwater and pool levels instead of treating one opening independently. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Opening discharge and coefficient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開口流量與係數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Opening discharge and coefficient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開口流量與係數
knowledge.text: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。用水深乘寬度建立面積之前，要確認開口是否完全被水淹沒，否則出流型態可能不同。
knowledge.textEn: An opening converts level difference into discharge. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses but changes with geometry, edges and submergence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開口流量與係數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Opening discharge and coefficient" is correct?
options: 流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同
魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。
optionsEn: A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool
An opening converts level difference into discharge.
quiz.explanation: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An opening converts level difference into discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開口流量與係數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Opening discharge and coefficient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。適用邊界：完全淹沒開口與給定有效係數，未把係數當通用常數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Fully submerged opening with an assumed effective coefficient, not a universal coefficient. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。適用邊界：完全淹沒開口與給定有效係數，未把係數當通用常數。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Fully submerged opening with an assumed effective coefficient, not a universal coefficient.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開口流量與係數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Opening discharge and coefficient", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。
誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比
孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless.
Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開口流量與係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Opening discharge and coefficient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。量開口實際尺寸及邊緣損傷，將堵塞與未堵塞資料分開；若係數不穩定，應辨認流態轉換而非只取全部平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Survey actual dimensions and edge damage. Separate blocked and clear conditions; unstable coefficients call for identifying regime changes rather than averaging every observation together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：使有效開口寬度縮小四分之一重算流量，再討論水位差可能隨之改變的情況。列出應同步觀測的池水位，說明為何單一開口不能獨立調整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce effective width by one quarter and recalculate discharge, then discuss possible changes in head difference. Identify pool levels that require simultaneous observation and explain why one opening cannot always be adjusted independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。量開口實際尺寸及邊緣損傷，將堵塞與未堵塞資料分開；若係數不穩定，應辨認流態轉換而非只取全部平均。
knowledge.textEn: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Survey actual dimensions and edge damage. Separate blocked and clear conditions; unstable coefficients call for identifying regime changes rather than averaging every observation together.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 使有效開口寬度縮小四分之一重算流量，再討論水位差可能隨之改變的情況。列出應同步觀測的池水位，說明為何單一開口不能獨立調整。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce effective width by one quarter and recalculate discharge, then discuss possible changes in head difference. Identify pool levels that require simultaneous observation and explain why one opening cannot always be adjusted independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開口流量與係數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Opening discharge and coefficient"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。
上下游原始計數相除必然等於真實通過機率
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence.
Dividing raw upstream by downstream counts necessarily gives the true passage probability
quiz.explanation: 在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開口流量與係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Opening discharge and coefficient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。只按閘門開度推流量會漏掉堵塞造成的網路連鎖反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Inferring discharge solely from gate position misses these blockage effects and their propagation through the connected passage system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：控制計算應與入口誘導、下游尾水及池內水位一起閉合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Close the calculation with attraction flow, tailwater and pool levels instead of treating one opening independently.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。只按閘門開度推流量會漏掉堵塞造成的網路連鎖反應。
knowledge.textEn: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Inferring discharge solely from gate position misses these blockage effects and their propagation through the connected passage system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開口流量與係數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Opening discharge and coefficient" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同
枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool
Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools.
quiz.explanation: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
